topic: Introduction to Engineering Metrology, need for inspection, precision and accuracy
syllabus_extract: Introduction to Engineering Metrology, need for inspection, precision and accuracy.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of standard measuring instruments; Safety: Handle glass/plastic scales gently; Supervision: Instructor monitors handling of fragile gauges.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of engineering metrology?
Why is inspection necessary in aircraft maintenance?
Can a measurement be accurate but not precise? Explain.

topics: Role of measurement in quality control
development.content:
Definition of Engineering Metrology
Scope and applications in aviation
Role of measurement in quality control
Basic units of measurement
Importance of standardization

topics: Impact of errors on aircraft safety
development.content:
Need for inspection in engineering
Difference between precision and accuracy
Sources of measurement errors
Significance of tolerance limits
Impact of errors on aircraft safety

Classification of measurement errors
Methods to improve measurement reliability
Role of calibration in metrology
Common instruments used for inspection
Summary of key concepts

summary_questions: Define precision and provide an example relevant to aircraft parts.
Explain how inspection prevents catastrophic failures in engineering systems.
Differentiate between accuracy and precision using a target analogy.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the objectives of metrology and its relationship with standardization for the next lesson on calibration.

pft_rows.syllabus: Importance of Calibration, classification of measurements, general care of instruments, objective of metrology, Standardization and various Standardizing organizations.
